# BAGO governance and contract instructions

Treat architecture, security, claim matrices, contracts, CI and Copilot governance files as high-consequence sources. A modification that changes canonical meaning requires explicit mutation authority and must preserve before/after traceability and supersession/version information where applicable. Never edit normative contracts merely to make an implementation conform. Changes to Copilot instructions/agents/skills/hooks must remain non-conflicting and evidence-scoped.
